name: detector
head: one2one (NMS-free) + one2many
input_format: RGB, NCHW, float32 in [0,1], square letterbox pad 114

metrics.eval: 99 held-out photos, full tiled pipeline (conf 0.1 / verify 0.2), IoU-matched against labels and against the previously deployed detector's outputs
metrics.parity: not at parity (v0.1.1); closer than v0.1.0 on box agreement at IoU 0.7 / 0.9

notes: v0.1.1. Detector fine-tuned from v0.1.0 with Pearson feature distillation; classifier is unchanged from v0.1.0. Detector is an approximation of the previously deployed detector and is not at parity.
